newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees better overall demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees better overall demand.

text.p: The London tea auction saw improved demand for both landed and offshore teas, the official report said. The next auction is on October 21.
In the landed sector, there was greater competition for Assams but despite some increase in prices for quality types most lost between two and five pence.
Brighter East Africans were firm to dearer with mediums steady while plainer descriptions saw some increases.
Among the offshores, Kenyas found better demand at fully firm rates but Zimbabwes tended easier.
